$comment: Engine/front-end boundary allowlist for docs-internal/ENGINE_MIGRATION_PLAN.md Arc 1. Each row is a packages/core/src file importing @lokascript/semantic, /intent or /i18n, counted per import KIND — static-value is the real debt, static-type and typeof-import erase at build time, dynamic defers. The list ratchets DOWN only: a new file, a risen count in any kind, and a stale row all fail scripts/check-semantic-boundary.cjs.

api/hyperscript-api.ts.reason: Two DYNAMIC imports only (compileMultilingual, fromLSECode), both deferred. The static-value import — `getSemanticAnalyzer()` building an analyzer for every compile(), so that every English compile() ran the front-end first for the 32 commands not on parseCommandCore's skip list — was deleted by Arc 1 step 6 (2026-09-02) with the in-loop path itself; the API now reaches the front-end only through `multilingual/bridge.ts`, whole-program, for a non-English compile. Arc 1 step 2 (`hyperscript.use(frontEnd)`) takes these two with it.

compatibility/browser-bundle-classic-i18.reason: LEGITIMATE and terminal. This IS the classic-i18n bundle; importing @lokascript/i18n/browser is its entire reason to exist. Target-state row.

compatibility/browser-bundle-multilingua.reason: LEGITIMATE. A `typeof import(...)` type query only — the module itself is loaded lazily by getSemanticModule(). Target-state row.

compatibility/browser-bundle-semantic-co.reason: LEGITIMATE and terminal. This IS the semantic-complete bundle. Target-state row.

compatibility/browser-bundle.ts.reason: LEGITIMATE. The full browser bundle ships the multilingual API on purpose (hyperfixi.semantic.*). Target-state row.

multilingual/bridge.ts.reason: The front-end module itself, and after Arc 1 step 3 the only core module allowed to import semantic. Already mostly deferred: one dynamic import plus type-only queries. Its static-value import (DEFAULT_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD) was removed in step 1 — the engine now owns that policy.

multilingual/index.ts.reason: Type-only. MultilingualHyperscript's public surface names SemanticNode/ASTNode. Front-end module; stays after Arc 1 step 3.

multilingual/schema-roles.ts.reason: LEGITIMATE and target-state. The schema-driven role inferrer `fromCoreAST` takes by injection (Arc 1 step 4). These two imports are the SAME two that ast-utils/interchange/from-core.ts used to hold — the step moved them from a file that must not import the front-end onto the front-end side of the line, so the static-value TOTAL is unchanged at 7. Both `multilingual/` rows are target-state under the ratchet's endpoint (compatibility/browser-bundle*.ts + multilingual/ only).
